title: Hack (TV series)
premise_summary: Hack is an American crime drama television series created by David Koepp that aired on CBS in the United States from September 27, 2002, to March 13, 2004, having 40 episodes broadcast over two seasons. The series centers on former Philadelphia police officer Mike Olshansky, who leaves the force after being accused of corruption and works as a taxi driver.
